title: John Wick: Chapter 2
tagline: A marker is a promise. Dinner is a promise too.
about: John is forced to honour a blood oath and travels to Rome for a job he doesn't want.
cue: Serve the wine when John visits the sommelier at the Rome Continental.
faces: EAT WHILE THE FIRES STILL BURN
